what_happened: Job 20261028-055601-hg0n ("Replay refusal-rule changes over 50 past readings before landing") ended failed before the verifier ran. The free-disk guard found 9.8 GB free where 10.0 GB is required before the verifier. The event's message says this is the environment, not the work. The work was not judged. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria, no blocker or major findings and no failed checks. The fix it names is to free disk by hand and run `athena retry`.
cause: Athena treats free disk as a fixed precondition it only checks. It does not reclaim its own build outputs and caches, and it does not reserve space for the verifier. The guard fires late, after the producer has already used the space, and only 0.2 GB short. The only remedy is an operator clearing disk and retrying. Replay work like this one builds old and new versions and so uses more disk than most jobs. Nothing at dispatch compares the likely disk need with what is free.
prevention: When the free-disk guard fires, or before the verifier starts, Athena should delete its own regenerable artifacts (old job build directories, target caches of finished or closed jobs) until the threshold is met, then continue the job. It should fail with the environment message only if cleanup cannot reach the threshold. It should log what it removed. Ideally the same check also runs at job dispatch, so a job does not start when the free space cannot cover the producer and verifier together.
proposed_request: When free disk falls below the verifier's required minimum (10 GB), Athena should reclaim space itself and continue the job, so that no operator has to clear disk and retry. Outcome: before the verifier starts, if free disk is under the threshold, Athena deletes only regenerable artifacts it owns (build directories and target caches of finished, failed or closed jobs, never the running job's snapshot or any records) until free space reaches the threshold, then runs the verifier. If it still cannot reach the threshold, the job ends failed with the existing environment message and also lists what was removed and how much space is still missing. Each cleanup is logged. Acceptance: (1) a test with a stubbed free-space reading just under the threshold and removable artifacts present shows cleanup runs and the verifier is then started; (2) a test where cleanup cannot free enough shows the environment failure message with the removed list; (3) a test shows the running job's files and the records are never deleted. After landing, retry job 20261028-055601-hg0n.
